incident.title: payment-service requests timing out, 5xx rising
incident.description: Since 2026-09-24 22:20 UTC many payment-service requests hang for seconds and then fail. The errors mention timeouts while talking to orders-db. CPU on the service and on the database looks normal.

cases.expected_root_cause: The orders-db connection pool of payment-service is exhausted: all 20 connections are in use (long-held connections / slow transactions waiting on row locks), so requests wait for a connection and time out. Not a CPU problem.

incident.title: checkout-api error rate up after today's release
incident.description: Shortly after checkout-api v4.1.2 was rolled out with ArgoCD, users started getting server errors and some of the new pods keep restarting.

cases.expected_root_cause: The v4.1.2 deployment of checkout-api is faulty: a NullPointerException in PricingEngine.applyDiscount (new pricing engine enabled by default) causes 500s and crash-looping pods only on v4.1.2; rolling back fixes it.

incident.title: inventory-service pods restarting every few hours
incident.description: inventory-service pods are killed and restarted regularly. Before each restart the service gets slower and its memory usage climbs steadily.

cases.expected_root_cause: Memory leak in inventory-service: the 'product-details' cache grows without eviction, the heap fills up to the 1024Mi limit and pods are OOMKilled and restarted.

incident.title: auth-service cannot reach its dependencies
incident.description: Since 2026-09-20 03:06 UTC outbound calls from auth-service fail with host lookup errors, although the dependencies themselves report healthy.

cases.expected_root_cause: DNS resolution failure: payments.internal.acme cannot be resolved because CoreDNS lookups to the upstream resolver 10.20.0.2 time out; the dependencies themselves are healthy.

incident.title: HTTPS failures on api.acme.example
incident.description: Clients calling api.acme.example (checkout-api) suddenly get secure connection errors since 2026-09-28 15:34 UTC. Nothing was deployed.

cases.expected_root_cause: The TLS certificate acme-api-tls for api.acme.example expired because its cert-manager renewal (ACME challenge) failed, so TLS handshakes fail.

incident.title: payment-service very slow, many timeouts
incident.description: payment-service p99 latency is many times higher than usual while its own CPU and database look fine. Calls to another service are timing out and being retried.

cases.expected_root_cause: The downstream dependency fraud-check became slow (p99 ~80ms -> ~1.9s), causing timeouts, retries and an open circuit breaker in payment-service; payment-service itself is healthy.
